rarity_line.zh: 全世界只有 1.5% 的人是这块千层。
rarity_line.en: Only 1.5% of people are this mille-feuille.

line.zh: 虽然你总能一眼看穿别人，但你从来只把看穿用来体谅。
line.en: You see straight through people, but you only ever use it to understand them.

line.zh: 虽然你半夜的问题没人答得上来，但正是这些问题，让你活得比别人深一层。
line.en: Nobody can answer the questions you ask at midnight, but those questions are why you live one layer deeper than everyone else.

line.zh: 虽然你永远先想到别人，但被你照顾过的人，都悄悄把你放在了第一位。
line.en: You always think of others first, but everyone you've looked after has quietly put you first too.

line.zh: 虽然你心里的千层波澜别人看不见，但你看世界的那份细腻，没人复制得来。
line.en: Nobody sees the thousand layers moving inside you, but nobody else notices the world the way you do.

q.zh: 聚会上有人讲了一个冷场的笑话
q.en: At a party, someone tells a joke and it dies

options.zh: 在他尴尬的 0.5 秒里笑出声，救场
options.en: You laugh out loud inside his half-second of panic. Saved.

options.zh: 你已经看出来，他今晚讲冷笑话是因为工作不顺
options.en: You've already worked out he's telling bad jokes tonight because work is going badly

options.zh: 表面微笑，心里已经替这个笑话写好三个更好的结尾
options.en: You smile, while writing three better endings for the joke in your head

options.zh: 开始想：人为什么需要别人笑，才觉得自己安全
options.en: You start wondering why people need someone to laugh before they feel safe

q.zh: 你发了一大段，对方只回了一个“哦”
q.en: You send a long message. The reply is "k"

options.zh: 把聊天记录往上翻，逐句排查自己哪里说错了
options.en: You scroll back up and check every line for what you said wrong

options.zh: 从这个“哦”的发送时间，推断出他此刻在开会
options.en: From the timestamp of that "k", you work out they're in a meeting

options.zh: 判断他大概很累，顺手给他点了一杯咖啡外卖
options.en: You decide they're probably exhausted, and order a coffee to their door

options.zh: 开始想：一千年后，人类会不会只剩一个字交流
options.en: You start wondering whether humans will be down to one-letter conversations in a thousand years

q.zh: 门口出现一个快递，收件人是你，但你什么都没买
q.en: A parcel turns up at your door. It's addressed to you. You didn't order anything

twist.zh: 其实是你三个月前半夜下单、自己忘了的东西。
twist.en: Turns out you ordered it yourself at 3am three months ago, and forgot.

options.zh: 越想越感动：一定是某个默默在乎你的人
options.en: The more you think about it, the more moved you get: someone out there quietly cares

options.zh: 研究胶带的缠法，推断寄件人的性格
options.en: You study how the tape was wrapped and deduce the sender's personality

options.zh: 先不拆，怕是别人寄错了，等对方来拿
options.en: You leave it sealed in case it's a mistake, and wait for someone to claim it

options.zh: 思考：一份没有署名的礼物，是送给你，还是送给“被惦记”这件事
options.en: You wonder: is an unsigned gift for you, or for the feeling of being thought of?

q.zh: 凌晨两点，你在
q.en: It's 2am. You are

options.zh: 备忘录里写一段永远不会发出去的长文
options.en: Writing a long note in your phone that you will never send

options.zh: 回想今天每个人的表情，给他们分别配上 BGM
options.en: Replaying everyone's face from today and giving each one a soundtrack

options.zh: 给明天考试的朋友写一句“你会好的”，定时早上 7 点发
options.en: Writing "you'll be okay" to a friend with an exam tomorrow, scheduled for 7am

options.zh: 盯着天花板，第三十七次想“我到底是谁”
options.en: Staring at the ceiling, asking "who am I, really?" for the thirty-seventh time

q.zh: 有人在你面前突然哭了
q.en: Someone suddenly starts crying in front of you

options.zh: 什么都不问，递纸巾，陪他坐到他想说为止
options.en: You ask nothing. You pass a tissue and sit there until they want to talk

options.zh: 你比他自己更早知道他为什么哭
options.en: You knew why they were crying before they did

options.zh: 跟着一起难过，回家路上还在替他想台词
options.en: You feel it with them, and you're still writing their lines for them on the way home

options.zh: 开始想：眼泪到底是流给自己的，还是流给别人看的
options.en: You start wondering: are tears for yourself, or for someone to see?

rarity_line.zh: 全世界只有 1.8% 的人能撑起这块歌剧院。
rarity_line.en: Only 1.8% of people can carry an opera cake.

line.zh: 虽然你一开口大家就自动开始分工，但正是有你，事情才真的会被做完。
line.en: The moment you speak, people start dividing up the work, but that's exactly why things actually get done.

line.zh: 虽然你总嫌事情推进太慢，但每次卡死的局面，都是你一句话打开的。
line.en: You always think things move too slowly, but every stuck situation was opened by one sentence from you.

line.zh: 虽然你的目标总让人觉得太大，但你说过的事，后来大多都成了真。
line.en: Your goals always sound too big, but most of what you said out loud came true.

line.zh: 虽然你连旅行都要做成项目，但跟你出门的人，从来没踩过坑。
line.en: You turn even a holiday into a project, but nobody who travels with you ever gets caught out.

q.zh: 朋友聚餐，讨论了半小时去哪吃
q.en: Dinner with friends. Half an hour spent on where to eat

options.zh: 直接拍板：“这家，七点，我订位。”
options.en: You call it: "This place. Seven. I'm booking."

options.zh: 列两个选项，限时一分钟投票
options.en: Two options, one minute to vote

options.zh: 选了一家最难订的，并且订到了
options.en: You pick the hardest table in town to get. You get it

options.zh: 顺便提议每月固定聚一次，下次谁组织你已经排好了
options.en: You also propose a fixed monthly dinner, and you've already scheduled who hosts next

q.zh: 小组作业有人一直不回消息
q.en: In a group project, one person has stopped replying

options.zh: 当场重新分工，他那部分你接了，再在群里说清楚
options.en: You reassign on the spot, take their part yourself, and spell it out in the chat

options.zh: 直接打电话过去，五分钟内拿到一个明确的交付时间
options.en: You call them, and have a firm delivery time within five minutes

options.zh: 顺手把这次作业做成了能写进简历的项目
options.en: While you're at it, you turn the assignment into something worth putting on a CV

options.zh: 建了一张进度表，所有人的状态一目了然
options.en: You build a progress sheet where everyone's status is visible at a glance

q.zh: 学校突然停电，所有人围在走廊发呆
q.en: The power cuts out at school. Everyone is standing around in the corridor

twist.zh: 其实只是这一层的保险丝跳了，物业三分钟就合上了。
twist.en: Turns out a fuse tripped on this one floor. The building office fixed it in three minutes.

options.zh: 已经在安排：谁去找物业，谁去看电梯里有没有人
options.en: You're already assigning: who finds the building office, who checks if anyone's stuck in the lift

options.zh: 打给物业问到恢复时间，宣布“十分钟后回来继续”
options.en: You call the building office, get a restore time, and announce "back in ten"

options.zh: 带大家去楼下咖啡厅开会，效率反而更高了
options.en: You move everyone to the café downstairs, and the meeting goes better there

options.zh: 把今天剩下的事按“需不需要电”重新排了一遍
options.en: You re-sort the rest of today's tasks by "needs power" and "doesn't"

q.zh: 玩桌游，大家都说只是随便玩玩
q.en: Board game night. Everyone says it's just for fun

options.zh: 三轮之后，你在指挥全桌的走法
options.en: Three rounds in, you're directing the whole table's moves

options.zh: 发现一个规则漏洞，一回合结束游戏
options.en: You find a loophole in the rules and end the game in one turn

options.zh: “随便玩玩”是不存在的。你赢了
options.en: "Just for fun" doesn't exist. You win

options.zh: 已经在研究最优策略，下次带攻略来
options.en: You're already working out the optimal strategy. Next time you bring notes

q.zh: 凌晨两点，你在
q.en: It's 2am. You are

options.zh: 回完明天要发的所有消息，排好定时发送
options.en: Replying to everything due tomorrow, and scheduling each message to send

options.zh: 终于想通了卡了一周的那个问题，马上写下来
options.en: Finally cracking the problem that's been stuck for a week, and writing it down at once

options.zh: 看某个创始人的访谈，看完把五年目标又往上调了一档
options.en: Watching a founder interview, then raising your five-year target one notch

options.zh: 搭一套新的 Notion 系统，用来管理你的整个人生
options.en: Building a new Notion system to manage your entire life

rarity_line.zh: 全世界只有 2.1% 的人是这块黑巧挞。
rarity_line.en: Only 2.1% of people are this dark chocolate tart.

line.zh: 虽然你计划好的事很少告诉别人，但等别人反应过来，你已经走到终点了。
line.en: You rarely tell anyone the plan, but by the time they catch on, you're already at the finish line.

line.zh: 虽然大家常听不懂你在担心什么，但三个月后，他们都会回来说“你当时说对了”。
line.en: People often don't get what you're worried about, but three months later they come back and say "you called it".

line.zh: 虽然你常被说不合群，但你一个人做成的事，往往比一群人开会还多。
line.en: People say you don't mix, but what you finish alone usually beats what a roomful gets done in a meeting.

line.zh: 虽然你对什么都挑剔，但被你认可过的东西，从来经得起时间。
line.en: You're picky about everything, but whatever earns your approval stands the test of time.

q.zh: 小组作业第一次开会，四十分钟还没进入正题
q.en: First group-project meeting. Forty minutes in, still not on topic

options.zh: 脑子里已经把整个项目拆完了，只是在等合适的时机开口
options.en: You broke the whole project down in your head long ago. You're just waiting for the right moment to speak

options.zh: 默默预测这组会在第几周崩，提前做好了备份方案
options.en: You quietly predict which week this group falls apart, and prepare a backup plan

options.zh: 说一句“这部分我来”，回家自己做完了一半
options.en: You say "I'll take this part", go home and finish half the project alone

options.zh: 盯着别人 PPT 里对不齐的字体，忍了很久
options.en: You stare at the misaligned fonts on someone's slides, and hold it in for a long time

q.zh: 朋友兴奋地拉你一起抽网红盲盒
q.en: A friend excitedly drags you to buy trendy blind boxes

options.zh: 先算一下：抽中隐藏款的期望花费是多少
options.en: First you work out the expected cost of landing the secret figure

options.zh: 判断这个 IP 半年后就没人记得，礼貌拒绝
options.en: You judge that nobody will remember this character in six months, and politely pass

options.zh: “你抽吧，我看着”，然后看了一下午
options.en: "You go ahead, I'll watch." You watch all afternoon

options.zh: 拿起来看了一眼做工，放回去了
options.en: You pick one up, inspect the build quality, and put it back

q.zh: 半夜手机弹出：“您的账户在异地登录”
q.en: Midnight. Your phone lights up: "New login to your account from another location"

twist.zh: 其实是你自己平板上的旧登录，系统刚刚才反应过来。
twist.en: Turns out it was your own tablet. An old login the system only just noticed.

options.zh: 冷静三步：改密码、查记录、开二次验证
options.en: Three calm steps: change password, check history, turn on two-factor

options.zh: 顺手把所有账号的密码全换了，以防下一次
options.en: While you're at it, you change the password on every account you own, for next time

options.zh: 不惊动任何人，自己一晚上查清楚
options.en: You wake nobody, and get to the bottom of it alone overnight

options.zh: 顺便发现这家公司的安全设计很烂，写了一份改进建议
options.en: You also notice the company's security design is poor, and write them a list of fixes

q.zh: 有人问你：“五年后想做什么？”
q.en: Someone asks: "Where do you see yourself in five years?"

options.zh: 给出一份五年计划，精确到每年第几季度
options.en: You hand over a five-year plan, broken down by quarter

options.zh: 反问：五年后这个行业还在不在
options.en: You ask back: will this industry still exist in five years?

options.zh: “我自己会知道的。”
options.en: "I'll know when I get there."

options.zh: 心里想：问这个问题的人，自己大概还没想清楚
options.en: You think: whoever asks this probably hasn't figured out their own answer

q.zh: 凌晨两点，你在
q.en: It's 2am. You are

options.zh: 第四次修改人生计划表
options.en: Revising your life plan for the fourth time

options.zh: 读一篇讲十年后世界的长文，读完觉得大家都太乐观了
options.en: Reading a long essay about the world in ten years, and concluding everyone is too optimistic

options.zh: 一个人把一件拖了三天的事做完了
options.en: Finishing, alone, the thing you put off for three days

options.zh: 重写一封邮件的第一句话，第七稿
options.en: Rewriting the first line of an email. Draft seven

rarity_line.zh: 全世界只有 2.5% 的人是这块草莓蛋糕。
rarity_line.en: Only 2.5% of people are this strawberry shortcake.

line.zh: 虽然你总操心大家开不开心，但正是因为你，这群人才一直是一群人。
line.en: You're always checking whether everyone's happy, but that's why this group is still a group.

line.zh: 虽然你夸别人比夸自己多太多，但被你夸过的人，后来真的都变好了。
line.en: You praise others far more than yourself, but the people you praised really did get better.

line.zh: 虽然你总相信事情能变得更好，但这份相信，常常就是让事情变好的那股力。
line.en: You always believe things can get better, but that belief is often the push that makes them better.

line.zh: 虽然你总忍不住给别人建议，但你的建议，总有人记了很多年。
line.en: You can't help giving advice, but someone always remembers it for years.

q.zh: 聚会上有个人一直没说话
q.en: At a party, one person hasn't said a word

options.zh: 自然地把话题引到他擅长的事上
options.en: You steer the conversation, naturally, to something they're good at

options.zh: 当众夸了他一句，他笑了一整晚
options.en: You compliment them in front of everyone. They smile for the rest of the night

options.zh: 心里已经在想：下次组局怎么安排，才能让每个人都舒服
options.en: You're already planning how to set up the next gathering so everyone's comfortable

options.zh: 散场后私聊他，聊到凌晨
options.en: You message them afterwards, and you talk until the small hours

q.zh: 朋友给你看他写的东西，其实写得一般
q.en: A friend shows you something they wrote. It's honestly average

options.zh: 拉了个小群，让大家一起给他出主意
options.en: You start a small group chat so everyone can help with ideas

options.zh: 先找出三个真正写得好的地方，具体地夸
options.en: You find three things that are truly good, and praise each one specifically

options.zh: 你真心觉得他能写得更好，所以说了实话
options.en: You really believe they can write better, so you tell them the truth

options.zh: 帮他想好了下一步怎么改，还附上了例子
options.en: You work out their next revision for them, with examples

q.zh: 群聊突然安静了一整天，没人说话
q.en: The group chat has been silent all day

twist.zh: 其实是你把群设成了免打扰，消息都在，只是你没看到。
twist.en: Turns out you'd muted the chat. The messages were all there. You just never saw them.

options.zh: 发一张大家的合照，配一句“想你们了”
options.en: You post a group photo: "miss you all"

options.zh: 翻出一个人最近的高光时刻，在群里夸他
options.en: You dig up someone's recent win and praise them in the chat

options.zh: 想了一个大家都会喜欢的周末计划，扔进群里
options.en: You come up with a weekend plan everyone will like and drop it in

options.zh: 挨个私聊，确认每个人都还好
options.en: You message each person privately to check they're okay

q.zh: 小组作业，有人做得很慢
q.en: Group project. One person is very slow

options.zh: 调整分工，让每个人都做自己最擅长的
options.en: You reshuffle the work so everyone does what they're best at

options.zh: 当众肯定他已经做好的部分，让他有动力
options.en: You praise, in front of the group, the part they've already done well

options.zh: 跟大家讲了一段话：这次作业其实可以做得很有意义
options.en: You give a short speech about how this assignment could actually mean something

options.zh: 主动陪他一起做，顺便教他方法
options.en: You sit down and do it with them, teaching the method as you go

q.zh: 凌晨两点，你在
q.en: It's 2am. You are

options.zh: 把好几个人的生日祝福提前写好，存在备忘录里
options.en: Writing several people's birthday messages in advance and saving them in your notes

options.zh: 突然想起今天谁做得很好，决定明天一定要告诉他
options.en: Suddenly remembering who did well today, and deciding to tell them tomorrow for sure

options.zh: 读一本讲怎么改变世界的书，读到眼眶发热
options.en: Reading a book about changing the world, eyes getting warm

options.zh: 回一个朋友很长的心事，回得比他的还长
options.en: Replying to a friend's long message about their troubles. Your reply is longer

rarity_line.zh: 全世界只有 3.2% 的人是这杯提拉米苏。
rarity_line.en: Only 3.2% of people are this tiramisu.

line.zh: 虽然总有人说你爱抬杠，但你追的从来不是输赢，是那个没人愿意挖到底的真相。
line.en: People say you love to argue, but you were never chasing the win. You're after the truth nobody else bothers to dig for.

line.zh: 虽然你的草稿箱比发出去的还多，但你随手一句，就是别人想半天想不出的梗。
line.en: Your drafts folder is bigger than your feed, but one throwaway line from you is the joke everyone else spent an hour failing to write.

line.zh: 虽然别人总说你想太多，但你只是比所有人早一步看到了第三步。
line.en: People say you overthink, but you just saw step three before anyone else finished step one.

line.zh: 虽然你总忍不住去戳一下规则，但很多规则，正是被你戳出漏洞才变得更好。
line.en: You can't resist poking at a rule, but plenty of rules only got better because you found the hole.

q.zh: 你被困在宜家样板间迷宫两小时
q.en: You've been lost in the IKEA showroom maze for two hours

options.zh: 小红书草稿已经打好：《被宜家困住两小时，我悟了》，九宫格都选好了
options.en: Your post is already drafted: "Trapped in IKEA for two hours. I have seen things." Nine photos picked.

options.zh: 开始算账：按时薪亏了多少、错过了哪几单外卖，再按刚才那杯水推算几点会尿急
options.en: You're doing the maths: wages lost, deliveries missed, and, based on that glass of water, the exact time you'll need a toilet

options.zh: 立刻打给朋友吐槽，挂电话时已经从宜家骂到了人类城市规划
options.en: You call a friend to rant, and by the time you hang up you've moved from IKEA to the failure of modern city planning

options.zh: 偷偷把鼻屎抹在样板间沙发底下
options.en: You quietly wipe a booger under the showroom sofa

q.zh: 群里有人认真转发：“金鱼只有 7 秒记忆”
q.en: Someone in the group chat earnestly forwards: "Goldfish only have a 7-second memory"

options.zh: 查到原始出处，顺便挖出这句话最早是哪个营销号编的
options.en: You track down the original source, and the content farm that made it up in the first place

options.zh: 截图转发到另一个群：“这个群有人信这个”
options.en: You screenshot it into another group chat: "Someone in the other chat believes this"

options.zh: 开始想：如果真的只有 7 秒，鱼缸里每天都是新世界，那它是不是比我幸福
options.en: You start wondering: if it really is 7 seconds, the tank is a brand-new world every day. Is the fish happier than me?

options.zh: 不纠正，顺着编一条更离谱的，数数有几个人信
options.en: You don't correct it. You add an even wilder "fact" and count how many people buy it

q.zh: 电梯突然停了，一直不动，灯也灭了
q.en: The lift suddenly stops. It stays stopped. Then the lights go out

twist.zh: 其实你只是没按楼层，电梯灯省电休眠了。
twist.en: Turns out you never pressed a floor. The lights just went into power-saving mode.

options.zh: 打开手电筒，先给自己录一条：“电梯停了第 0 分钟，留个记录”
options.en: Torch on, and you film yourself first: "Lift stuck, minute zero. For the record."

options.zh: 按人数和轿厢大小推算氧气还能撑多久，算完发现其实够，有点失望
options.en: You estimate the oxygen from the headcount and the size of the lift, find there's plenty, and feel slightly let down

options.zh: 跟同梯陌生人争论：现在该先按警铃还是先打电话
options.en: You debate the stranger next to you: alarm button first, or phone call first?

options.zh: 把所有按钮按一遍，包括那个不知道干嘛的钥匙孔
options.en: You press every button, including the keyhole thing nobody understands

q.zh: 凌晨两点，你在
q.en: It's 2am. You are

options.zh: 在评论区追问一个说法的出处，追到对方答不上来、把你拉黑
options.en: In a comment section asking someone for their source, until they run out of answers and block you

options.zh: 录一条“凌晨两点的我”口播，准备明天发
options.en: Recording a "me at 2am" voice-over to post tomorrow

options.zh: 规划一个永远不会做的创业项目，logo 都想好了
options.en: Planning a startup you will never build. The logo is done

options.zh: 在家族群发一个只有 emoji 的谜语，等明早看谁先破解
options.en: Sending the family chat an emoji-only riddle, to see who cracks it by morning

q.zh: 被拉去听一场超无聊的讲座
q.en: You've been dragged to a painfully boring talk

options.zh: 连环举手，一个问完接下一个，问到讲者开始翻自己的 PPT 找答案
options.en: Hand up, again and again, until the speaker starts flipping through their own slides for answers

options.zh: 偷偷录了几段，回家剪成一条锐评视频
options.en: You secretly film a few clips to cut into a review video at home

options.zh: 五分钟摸清套路，开始小声给同伴预告讲者下一句，说中了就补一句“你看，我就说吧”
options.en: Five minutes in you've cracked the pattern, so you whisper the speaker's next line to your friend. When it lands: "See? Told you."

options.zh: 听了十分钟，判断不值得，直接起身离场
options.en: Ten minutes in you decide it isn't worth it, stand up and leave

rarity_line.zh: 全世界只有 3.3% 的人是这块咖啡冻。
rarity_line.en: Only 3.3% of people are this coffee jelly.

line.zh: 虽然你问“为什么”能问到别人想跑，但你理解一件事，是真的理解到了底。
line.en: You ask "why" until people want to run, but when you understand something, you understand it to the bottom.

line.zh: 虽然你的脑子一天开五十个窗口，但随便一个，都比别人的整套想法有意思。
line.en: Your brain has fifty tabs open, but any one of them is more interesting than most people's whole plan.

line.zh: 虽然你常为一个用词纠正别人，但你说出口的话，几乎找不到漏洞。
line.en: You'll correct a single word, but it's almost impossible to find a hole in what you say.

line.zh: 虽然你的兴趣冷门到没人能聊，但你在那个领域知道的，比大部分人一辈子都多。
line.en: Your interests are too niche to chat about, but you know more in that one field than most people learn in a lifetime.

q.zh: 有人说：“这个道理大家都懂。”
q.en: Someone says: "Everybody knows that."

options.zh: 追问：具体是哪个道理，懂到什么程度
options.en: You ask: which thing exactly, and how well do they know it?

options.zh: 开始想：如果大家都懂，为什么还要说出来
options.en: You start wondering: if everybody knows it, why say it out loud?

options.zh: 纠正：“大家”这个范围太大了，样本是多少
options.en: You correct them: "everybody" is a big claim. What's the sample size?

options.zh: 想起一个相关的冷知识，讲了二十分钟
options.en: It reminds you of a related obscure fact. You talk for twenty minutes

q.zh: 你本来要回一条消息
q.en: You meant to reply to a message

options.zh: 打了三段又全删了，因为发现问题本身就问错了
options.en: You type three paragraphs and delete them all, because the question itself was wrong

options.zh: 回复在脑子里写好了，所以你以为已经发了
options.en: You wrote the reply in your head, so you believe you sent it

options.zh: 改了四遍措辞，确保每个词都准确
options.en: You reword it four times so every word is accurate

options.zh: 想着想着，开始研究这个 App 的推送机制
options.en: Mid-thought, you start investigating how the app's notifications work

q.zh: 家里 Wi-Fi 突然断了，路由器的灯全亮着
q.en: The Wi-Fi drops at home. Every light on the router is still on

twist.zh: 其实是家人改了 Wi-Fi 密码，没告诉你。
twist.en: Turns out someone at home changed the Wi-Fi password and didn't tell you.

options.zh: 排除法：是网络、设备，还是运营商
options.en: Process of elimination: the network, the device, or the provider?

options.zh: 想到如果全世界同时断网，第一天会发生什么
options.en: You imagine what day one looks like if the whole world goes offline at once

options.zh: 开命令行测了一遍延迟，精确到毫秒
options.en: You open a terminal and measure the latency, to the millisecond

options.zh: 趁断网把路由器拆开，研究里面的结构
options.en: No internet anyway, so you open up the router to see how it's built

q.zh: 有人推荐你看一部很火的剧
q.en: Someone recommends a hugely popular show

options.zh: 先看了一个“这部剧为什么火”的分析视频
options.en: First you watch a video essay on why the show is popular

options.zh: 看到一半，开始自己构想一个更合理的结局
options.en: Halfway through, you start designing an ending that makes more sense

options.zh: 发现三个设定上的逻辑漏洞，记进了备忘录
options.en: You find three logic holes in the world-building and log them in your notes

options.zh: 只看了第一集，然后去研究它的拍摄技术
options.en: You watch one episode, then go and research how it was filmed

q.zh: 凌晨两点，你在
q.en: It's 2am. You are

options.zh: 想通了一个困扰你三年的问题，然后发现没人可以分享
options.en: Solving a question that's bothered you for three years, then realising there's nobody to tell

options.zh: 设计一套完全没用、但逻辑完美的新语言
options.en: Designing a new language that is completely useless and logically perfect

options.zh: 改一段代码，只为了让它少一行
options.en: Rewriting a piece of code just to make it one line shorter

options.zh: 维基百科跳了四十个链接，从咖啡跳到了罗马帝国的税制
options.en: Forty Wikipedia links deep. You started at coffee and you're now at Roman tax policy

rarity_line.zh: 100 个人里只有 4 个是这块巴斯克，懂的人都在抢。
rarity_line.en: Only 4 in 100 people are this Basque. The ones who know, fight for it.

line.zh: 虽然你总是先冲再想，但等别人想好的时候，你已经做完回来了。
line.en: You charge in before you think, but by the time others finish thinking, you're done and back.

line.zh: 虽然你干过的事让朋友心惊胆战，但他们最爱讲的故事，主角都是你。
line.en: The things you've done terrify your friends, but you star in all their favourite stories.

line.zh: 虽然你从不提前准备，但每次临场，你都是全场反应最快的那一个。
line.en: You never prepare, but in the moment you're the fastest mind in the room.

line.zh: 虽然你说话直接到有点扎人，但你看事情的准，大家都服。
line.en: You're blunt enough to sting, but everyone respects how accurately you read things.

q.zh: 朋友说：“要不周末去爬山吧？”
q.en: A friend says: "Shall we go hiking this weekend?"

options.zh: “现在就去。”
options.en: "Let's go now."

options.zh: 提议换一条没开发过的野路线
options.en: You propose an unmarked trail instead

options.zh: 什么都没带就出发了，路上缺什么买什么
options.en: You set off with nothing and buy what you need on the way

options.zh: 先查天气，发现周末下雨，直接改成今天
options.en: You check the forecast, see rain on the weekend, and move it to today

q.zh: 你在一个谁都不认识的聚会上
q.en: You're at a party where you know nobody

options.zh: 五分钟后在帮主人搬桌子，十分钟后在帮他点歌
options.en: Five minutes in you're helping the host move a table. Ten minutes in you're choosing the music

options.zh: 提议大家玩一个刺激的游戏
options.en: You propose a game with some risk in it

options.zh: 有人冷场，你一句话就接住了
options.en: The room goes quiet, and one line from you rescues it

options.zh: 已经看出来这群人里谁说了算
options.en: You've already worked out who in this crowd calls the shots

q.zh: 骑车到半路，导航突然没声音了
q.en: You're cycling. Halfway there, the navigation goes silent

twist.zh: 其实是你刚才不小心把手机调成了静音。
twist.en: Turns out you'd knocked your phone onto silent.

options.zh: 停下两秒，拿起手机三下搞定，继续走
options.en: You stop for two seconds, fix it in three taps, and ride on

options.zh: 干脆不导了，看看能骑到哪
options.en: You switch it off and see where you end up

options.zh: 凭感觉骑，反正大方向没错
options.en: You ride by feel. The general direction is right

options.zh: 你本来就记得路，导航只是开着而已
options.en: You knew the way anyway. The navigation was only on for company

q.zh: 有人跟你说：“这个你肯定做不到。”
q.en: Someone tells you: "You'll never manage that."

options.zh: 你已经开始做了
options.en: You've already started

options.zh: 你不仅做了，还加大了难度
options.en: You do it, and you make it harder

options.zh: 你当场想出一个他没想到的办法
options.en: You come up with a way they hadn't thought of, on the spot

options.zh: 你算了一下，确实做不到，于是换了一个更聪明的方式赢他
options.en: You work it out, agree it can't be done, and beat them a smarter way

q.zh: 凌晨两点，你在
q.en: It's 2am. You are

options.zh: 刚从外面回来，今天的事还挺精彩
options.en: Just home. Today was a good one

options.zh: 跟朋友临时决定去一个从没去过的地方
options.en: Deciding with friends to go somewhere none of you have been

options.zh: 在一个突然开始的局里，玩得最开心的是你
options.en: At a party that started out of nowhere, having the best time of anyone

options.zh: 睡了，明天还有正事
options.en: Asleep. There's real work tomorrow

rarity_line.zh: 100 个人里只有 4 个是这份舒芙蕾，要趁热。
rarity_line.en: Only 4 in 100 people are this soufflé. Catch it while it's warm.

line.zh: 虽然你总被说太理想化，但你守着的那份纯粹，是这个世界最稀缺的东西。
line.en: People say you're too idealistic, but the purity you guard is the rarest thing there is.

line.zh: 虽然别人的难过总会跑进你心里，但被你接住过的人，都记得那份温度。
line.en: Other people's sadness walks straight into you, but everyone you caught remembers how warm it felt.

line.zh: 虽然你常在现实里走神，但你脑子里的那个世界，比现实精彩太多。
line.en: You drift off in the real world, but the one in your head is far better.

line.zh: 虽然你看起来软软的，但你认定的事，谁都改变不了。
line.en: You look soft, but nobody can move you once you've decided.

q.zh: 路上看到一只淋雨的流浪猫
q.en: You see a stray cat out in the rain

options.zh: 想：它是不是也在等某个人
options.en: You wonder whether it's waiting for someone too

options.zh: 停下来，把伞挡在它头上，自己淋着
options.en: You stop and hold your umbrella over it while you get wet

options.zh: 已经在心里给它写好了一整个身世
options.en: You've already written its entire backstory in your head

options.zh: 第二天带着猫粮回到同一个地方，连续去了一周
options.en: You come back the next day with cat food. And every day that week

q.zh: 有人说你的梦想“不太现实”
q.en: Someone says your dream is "not very realistic"

options.zh: 心里想：现实本来就不该是唯一的标准
options.en: You think: reality was never meant to be the only measure

options.zh: 你理解他这么说，因为他自己也放弃过什么
options.en: You understand why they said it. They gave something up once too

options.zh: 你已经在想象实现那天，他脸上的表情
options.en: You're already picturing their face on the day it comes true

options.zh: 笑笑不解释，回家默默又往前做了一点
options.en: You smile, explain nothing, go home and quietly do a little more

q.zh: 隔壁传来很轻的哭声，持续了很久
q.en: Soft crying comes through the wall from next door. It goes on a long time

twist.zh: 其实是邻居在追一部很虐的剧，第二天还在楼下跟你安利。
twist.en: Turns out your neighbour was watching a tragic drama. They recommend it to you downstairs the next day.

options.zh: 有点难过，想到这世界上有很多人在一个人哭
options.en: You feel a little sad, thinking how many people are crying alone right now

options.zh: 想敲门又怕打扰，最后在门口放了一张小纸条
options.en: You want to knock but don't want to intrude, so you leave a small note at their door

options.zh: 已经在脑子里编好了一个让人心碎的故事
options.en: You've already written a heartbreaking story about it in your head

options.zh: 决定如果明天还在哭，就一定去问一问
options.en: You decide that if it's still going tomorrow, you will ask

q.zh: 听到一首歌，突然很想哭
q.en: A song comes on, and suddenly you want to cry

options.zh: 把它加进一个只给自己听的歌单
options.en: You add it to a playlist that is only for you

options.zh: 单曲循环到凌晨，在歌词里找到了自己
options.en: You loop it until the small hours and find yourself in the lyrics

options.zh: 给这首歌想象了一支 MV，主角是你自己
options.en: You imagine a music video for it. You're the lead

options.zh: 记下来，决定以后要写出一首这样的歌
options.en: You note it down and decide that one day you'll write a song like that

q.zh: 凌晨两点，你在
q.en: It's 2am. You are

options.zh: 写一篇不打算给任何人看的日记
options.en: Writing a diary entry nobody will ever read

options.zh: 反复读朋友今天说的一句话，担心他是不是不开心
options.en: Rereading something a friend said today, worried they weren't okay

options.zh: 在脑子里继续一个已经写了好几年的故事
options.en: Continuing, in your head, a story you've been writing for years

options.zh: 偷偷推进一个没人知道的作品，又多写了一页
options.en: Secretly adding one more page to a project nobody knows about

rarity_line.zh: 100 个人里只有 5 个是这碗布丁，话少但靠谱。
rarity_line.en: Only 5 in 100 people are this crème caramel. Few words, all reliable.

line.zh: 虽然你在最乱的时候看起来最不着急，但最后收拾局面的总是你。
line.en: You look the least worried when things are at their messiest, but you're the one who cleans it up in the end.

line.zh: 虽然你家有一抽屉拆开了还没装回去的东西，但你修好过的，比买过的还多。
line.en: You have a drawer of things you took apart and never put back, but you've fixed more than you've bought.

line.zh: 虽然你常常一声不响就消失一下午，但你回来时，总带着别人没见过的东西。
line.en: You vanish for a whole afternoon without a word, but you always come back with something nobody's seen.

line.zh: 虽然你说话从不超过三句，但那三句，正好解决问题。
line.en: You never say more than three sentences, but those three solve the problem.

q.zh: 朋友的手机突然黑屏，开不了机
q.en: A friend's phone goes black and won't turn on

options.zh: 接过来，一言不发地开始按组合键
options.en: You take it, say nothing, and start trying button combinations

options.zh: 已经在想要不要把它拆开看看
options.en: You're already wondering whether to open it up

options.zh: 让他先别急，你出去溜达一圈，回来脑子清楚了再弄
options.en: You tell them not to panic, go for a walk, and deal with it when your head is clear

options.zh: “楼下那家，三十块，送修。”
options.en: "The shop downstairs. Thirty bucks. Send it in."

q.zh: 被拉进一个超长的语音会议
q.en: You're pulled into an endless voice meeting

options.zh: 大家吵完，你说一句：“所以下一步是？”
options.en: When everyone's done arguing, you say one thing: "So what's the next step?"

options.zh: 开着会，顺手把耳机的线头拆开修好了
options.en: During the meeting, you repair the frayed wire on your earphones

options.zh: 找了个理由退出，骑车出门了
options.en: You find an excuse to drop off, and go for a bike ride

options.zh: 静音，做自己的事，轮到你时只说一句结论
options.en: Muted, doing your own work. When it's your turn, you give one line: the conclusion

q.zh: 半夜家里传来“咔哒、咔哒”的声音，一直不停
q.en: Midnight. Something in the flat goes "click… click… click" and doesn't stop

twist.zh: 其实是冰箱在自动制冰。
twist.en: Turns out it was the fridge making ice.

options.zh: 躺着不动，先判断声音的来源和规律
options.en: You lie still and work out the source and the rhythm first

options.zh: 拿上手电筒和螺丝刀，直接去找
options.en: You grab a torch and a screwdriver and go to find it

options.zh: 反正睡不着，干脆起来出门夜跑
options.en: You can't sleep anyway, so you go for a night run

options.zh: 判断不危险，戴上耳塞接着睡
options.en: You judge it harmless, put in earplugs and go back to sleep

q.zh: 你买了一个新东西
q.en: You bought something new

options.zh: 发现一个设计缺陷，自己想办法绕了过去
options.en: You find a design flaw and work out your own way around it

options.zh: 用了一周，开始研究怎么改装它
options.en: After a week you start researching how to modify it

options.zh: 带着它去了一个没人去过的地方测试
options.en: You take it somewhere nobody goes, to test it

options.zh: 说明书没看，十分钟就会用了
options.en: No manual. You've figured it out in ten minutes

q.zh: 凌晨两点，你在
q.en: It's 2am. You are

options.zh: 修好了白天困扰全组的那个 bug，没告诉任何人
options.en: Fixing the bug that stumped the whole team all day. Telling nobody

options.zh: 拆一个旧耳机，只是想看看里面长什么样
options.en: Taking apart an old pair of earphones, just to see what's inside

options.zh: 一个人骑车去吃夜宵
options.en: Cycling out alone for supper

options.zh: 睡觉。睡不着就看会儿天花板，也挺好
options.en: Asleep. Or looking at the ceiling, which is also fine

rarity_line.zh: 全世界 8.1% 的人都是快乐来源，你是其中一个。
rarity_line.en: 8.1% of people are walking happiness. You're one of them.

line.zh: 虽然你的计划三天一变，但你眼里的世界，永远比别人多一扇门。
line.en: Your plans change every three days, but your world always has one more door than everyone else's.

line.zh: 虽然你的兴奋常常来得莫名其妙，但只要你一开心，整个房间都跟着亮了。
line.en: Your excitement often comes out of nowhere, but when you're happy the whole room lights up.

line.zh: 虽然你常常把心事说得太快，但你给出去的每一份好，都是真的。
line.en: You share your heart a little too fast, but every good thing you give is real.

line.zh: 虽然你讨厌任何被规定好的路，但你走出来的路，后来总有人跟着走。
line.en: You hate any path laid out for you, but people end up following the one you made.

q.zh: 朋友随口说：“好想去海边啊。”
q.en: A friend says, offhand: "I'd love to go to the beach."

options.zh: 十分钟后，你已经查好了票、民宿和三个没人知道的海滩
options.en: Ten minutes later you've found tickets, a guesthouse and three beaches nobody knows about

options.zh: 你比他还兴奋，已经在挑要穿哪件衣服了
options.en: You're more excited than they are, and already choosing an outfit

options.zh: 你认真问他：是不是最近太累了
options.en: You ask, sincerely, whether they've been worn out lately

options.zh: 你说“走”，然后真的就走了
options.en: You say "let's go". And you actually go

q.zh: 你开始了一个新爱好
q.en: You've picked up a new hobby

options.zh: 第一周就想好了怎么把它变成副业
options.en: By week one you've worked out how to turn it into a side business

options.zh: 拉了五个朋友一起入坑
options.en: You pull five friends into it with you

options.zh: 发了一条长帖，讲它为什么让你感动
options.en: You write a long post about why it moved you

options.zh: 第三周换成了另一个，因为路上遇到了更有意思的
options.en: By week three it's a different one, because something better turned up on the way

q.zh: 走在路上，突然有个陌生人叫出你的名字
q.en: You're walking down the street. A stranger calls out your name

twist.zh: 其实是你三年前在一个活动上加过的人，你们只聊过一次。
twist.en: Turns out you added them at an event three years ago. You've spoken once.

options.zh: 已经在想：这会不会是一段奇妙缘分的开始
options.en: You're already wondering if this is the start of something magical

options.zh: 立刻接上话，好像你们昨天才见过
options.en: You pick the conversation right up, as if you met yesterday

options.zh: 坦白说自己想不起来了，然后真诚地道歉
options.en: You admit you can't place them, and apologise like you mean it

options.zh: 顺势跟他去喝了杯咖啡，原本的计划全取消了
options.en: You go for coffee with them on the spot. Your original plans are cancelled

q.zh: 你在排一条很长的队
q.en: You're in a very long queue

options.zh: 想出一个“排队时玩的小游戏” App 点子
options.en: You come up with an app idea: mini-games for people stuck in queues

options.zh: 跟前后的人聊成了朋友，还互加了账号
options.en: You befriend the people in front and behind, and swap accounts

options.zh: 帮前面拎不动东西的老奶奶拎了一路
options.en: You carry an old lady's shopping for her the whole way

options.zh: 排到一半发现旁边有个更好玩的，果断换了队
options.en: Halfway through you spot something more fun next door, and switch queues

q.zh: 凌晨两点，你在
q.en: It's 2am. You are

options.zh: 列一张“今年想做的 47 件事”，越写越兴奋
options.en: Listing "47 things to do this year", getting more excited with each one

options.zh: 给朋友发了一串语音，说你刚想到一个超棒的主意
options.en: Sending a friend a string of voice notes about the brilliant idea you just had

options.zh: 想起一个很久没联系的人，给他发了句“我想起你了”
options.en: Remembering someone you haven't spoken to in ages, and texting "thought of you"

options.zh: 临时改了明天的计划，因为突然想去一个从没去过的地方
options.en: Changing tomorrow's plan, because you suddenly want to go somewhere you've never been

rarity_line.zh: 全世界 8.5% 的人负责让夏天变好玩，你是其中一个。
rarity_line.en: 8.5% of people make summer fun. You're one of them.

line.zh: 虽然你一出现场子就吵起来了，但没有你的局，大家连照片都不想拍。
line.en: Every room gets louder when you walk in, but without you nobody even wants to take the photo.

line.zh: 虽然你想一出是一出，朋友的心脏有点受不了，但他们最难忘的回忆里全都有你。
line.en: Your sudden ideas are hard on your friends' hearts, but you're in every one of their best memories.

line.zh: 虽然你总把最好玩的位置让给别人，但大家记得最清楚的，偏偏是你。
line.en: You always give the best seat to someone else, but you're the one everybody remembers.

line.zh: 虽然你的兴趣换得比谁都快，但你尝过的人生滋味，也比谁都多。
line.en: Your interests change faster than anyone's, but you've tasted more of life than anyone too.

q.zh: KTV 里没人敢点第一首
q.en: Karaoke. Nobody dares to pick the first song

options.zh: 抢过麦，点一首全场都会的，第一句就站上沙发
options.en: You grab the mic, pick one everybody knows, and you're standing on the sofa by the first line

options.zh: 点一首谁都没听过的小语种歌，硬唱到底
options.en: You pick a song in a language nobody speaks and commit to the end

options.zh: 把麦塞给最害羞的那个，然后陪他一起唱
options.en: You hand the mic to the shyest person, then sing it with them

options.zh: 一口气点了十首，唱两句就跑去研究点歌机的灯光模式
options.en: You queue ten songs, sing two lines, and wander off to play with the lighting modes

q.zh: 突然下大雨，你被困在便利店门口
q.en: Sudden downpour. You're stuck outside a convenience store

options.zh: 跟店员和其他躲雨的人组成临时小团体，开始下注雨几点停
options.en: You form a temporary gang with the cashier and everyone else sheltering, and start betting on when it stops

options.zh: 直接冲进雨里：就当免费淋浴
options.en: You run straight into it: free shower

options.zh: 把伞借给赶时间的陌生人，自己继续等
options.en: You lend your umbrella to a stranger in a hurry and keep waiting

options.zh: 买了一支冰淇淋，吃到一半雨停了，又买了一支
options.en: You buy an ice cream. The rain stops halfway through. You buy another

q.zh: 逛商场，突然所有灯一起熄灭，音乐也停了
q.en: You're in a mall. Every light goes out at once, and the music stops

twist.zh: 其实是商场在准备生日惊喜，蛋糕已经推出来了，不是给你的。
twist.en: Turns out the mall was setting up a birthday surprise. The cake is rolling out. It's not for you.

options.zh: 第一个尖叫，然后带头笑
options.en: First to scream, first to laugh

options.zh: 打开手机闪光灯，当场开起演唱会
options.en: Phone torch on. It's a concert now

options.zh: 先确认身边的朋友都在
options.en: You check your friends are all still next to you

options.zh: 拍一张全黑的照片发朋友圈：“猜我在哪”
options.en: You post a pitch-black photo: "Guess where I am"

q.zh: 凌晨两点，你在
q.en: It's 2am. You are

options.zh: 还在外面，刚认识的朋友说要去吃第三摊
options.en: Still out. The friends you made tonight want a third supper spot

options.zh: 临时决定打车去海边等日出
options.en: In a cab to the beach to wait for sunrise. You decided ten minutes ago

options.zh: 跟心情不好的朋友视频，逗到他笑出鼻涕泡
options.en: On a video call with a sad friend, making them laugh until they snort

options.zh: 打开购物车，关上，又打开
options.en: Opening your shopping cart. Closing it. Opening it again

q.zh: 有人送了你一盆植物
q.en: Someone gives you a potted plant

options.zh: 给它起名字，周末带它一起去聚会
options.en: You name it and bring it to the party this weekend

options.zh: 第二天就把它搬到阳台最晒的地方：带它见见世面
options.en: Next day you move it to the sunniest spot on the balcony: "time you saw the world"

options.zh: 每天跟它说早安，比对自己还上心
options.en: You say good morning to it every day, and treat it better than yourself

options.zh: 前三天天天浇水，第四天开始忘了它的存在
options.en: Watered daily for three days. On day four you forget it exists

rarity_line.zh: 全世界 8.7% 的人撑着所有小组作业，你是其中一个。
rarity_line.en: 8.7% of people hold every group project together. You're one of them.

line.zh: 虽然你总是第一个催进度的人，但最后能准时交的项目，背后都站着你。
line.en: You're always first to chase the deadline, but behind every project delivered on time, there's you.

line.zh: 虽然你把太多事扛在自己身上，但你答应过的，从来没有一件落空。
line.en: You carry too much on your own shoulders, but nothing you promised has ever fallen through.

line.zh: 虽然你对乱糟糟的东西零容忍，但被你整理过的地方，大家都舍不得离开。
line.en: You have zero tolerance for mess, but nobody wants to leave a place after you've organised it.

line.zh: 虽然你说话直到有人会愣一下，但跟着你的队伍，从来没迷过路。
line.en: You're direct enough to make people blink, but a team behind you has never got lost.

q.zh: 小组作业第一次开会，没人说话
q.en: First group-project meeting. Nobody speaks

options.zh: 任务清单已经发在群里了
options.en: The task list is already in the chat

options.zh: 主动认领了最难的那部分
options.en: You volunteer for the hardest part

options.zh: 建好共享文件夹，命名规则都写好了
options.en: The shared folder is set up, naming rules included

options.zh: 直接开口：“先分工，十分钟后定截止日期。”
options.en: You open: "Roles first. Deadline fixed in ten minutes."

q.zh: 朋友家乱成一团，他说“随便坐”
q.en: A friend's place is a mess. "Sit anywhere," they say

options.zh: 走的时候顺手把他的垃圾带下楼了
options.en: You take their rubbish down with you when you leave

options.zh: 想：他最近一定很忙，下次来帮他做顿饭
options.en: You think: they must be swamped lately. Next time you'll cook them a meal

options.zh: 坐下了，但花了十分钟才忍住没动手整理
options.en: You sit. It takes ten minutes of effort not to start tidying

options.zh: 给他推荐了一套收纳方法，说好下周来检查
options.en: You recommend a storage system and promise to inspect next week

q.zh: 到了订好的餐厅，前台说查不到你的预订
q.en: You arrive at the restaurant you booked. They can't find your reservation

twist.zh: 其实你订的是同名的另一家分店，就在马路对面。
twist.en: Turns out you booked the other branch with the same name. It's across the road.

options.zh: 两分钟内找到附近另一家能马上入座的
options.en: Within two minutes you've found another place nearby with a free table

options.zh: 先跟大家道歉，说是自己没确认好
options.en: You apologise to everyone first: you should have double-checked

options.zh: 拿出截图、时间和确认短信，冷静地跟前台对质
options.en: Screenshot, time, confirmation text. You calmly lay it out for the host

options.zh: 跟朋友说“交给我”，然后真的搞定了
options.en: You tell your friends "leave it to me". And you do sort it out

q.zh: 有人在会上说：“我们下次再讨论吧。”
q.en: In a meeting, someone says: "Let's discuss it next time."

options.zh: “下次是哪天几点？”
options.en: "Next time is which day, what time?"

options.zh: “这个我会后跟进”，然后真的跟进了
options.en: "I'll follow up after." And you do

options.zh: 当场记下待办和负责人
options.en: You write down the action item and its owner on the spot

options.zh: 接过话头，把讨论推进到有结论为止
options.en: You take over and push the discussion through to a decision

q.zh: 凌晨两点，你在
q.en: It's 2am. You are

options.zh: 检查明天要交的东西，确认每一项都齐了
options.en: Checking tomorrow's submission, item by item

options.zh: 还在回组员的问题，因为他明天要用
options.en: Still answering a teammate's question, because they need it tomorrow

options.zh: 睡觉。明天七点要起
options.en: Asleep. You're up at seven

options.zh: 规划下个月的安排，顺便发现了一个隐患
options.en: Planning next month, and spotting a risk nobody else has seen

rarity_line.zh: 全世界 8.8% 的人负责让世界好看，你是其中一个。
rarity_line.en: 8.8% of people keep the world beautiful. You're one of them.

line.zh: 虽然你挑东西挑到朋友想走，但你挑中的，从来没出过错。
line.en: You take so long choosing that your friends want to leave, but what you choose is never wrong.

line.zh: 虽然你常常需要一个人待着，但你独处时攒下的温柔，最后都给了身边的人。
line.en: You need a lot of time alone, but the gentleness you build up there all goes to the people around you.

line.zh: 虽然你会为了一块好吃的甜点绕半个城，但你过的每一天，都比别人多一点滋味。
line.en: You'll cross half the city for one good dessert, but every day of yours has a little more flavour than other people's.

line.zh: 虽然你常常临时改主意，但你跟着心走的样子，比任何计划都好看。
line.en: You change your mind at the last minute, but you following your heart looks better than any plan.

q.zh: 你走进一家咖啡店
q.en: You walk into a café

options.zh: 先看灯光和杯子好不好看，再决定点什么
options.en: You check the lighting and the cups before you decide what to order

options.zh: 挑了角落最安静的位置，坐了一整个下午
options.en: You take the quietest corner and stay all afternoon

options.zh: 点了菜单上最奇怪的那款，喝一口就爱上了
options.en: You order the strangest thing on the menu, and love it at the first sip

options.zh: 本来是去喝咖啡的，最后买了店里的一个杯子走了
options.en: You came for coffee. You leave having bought one of their cups

q.zh: 朋友让你帮忙挑衣服
q.en: A friend asks you to help pick clothes

options.zh: 一眼挑中最适合他的那件，他自己都没想到
options.en: You spot the one that suits them best at a glance. They hadn't even considered it

options.zh: 陪他逛，心里在想晚上回家画什么
options.en: You go along, thinking about what you'll paint tonight

options.zh: 摸了一下面料：“这件穿起来会很舒服。”
options.en: You feel the fabric: "This one will be comfortable."

options.zh: 逛到最后，你自己买了三件
options.en: By the end you've bought three things for yourself

q.zh: 你常去的那家小店突然关门了，门上什么都没贴
q.en: The little shop you always go to is suddenly shut. Nothing on the door

twist.zh: 其实老板只是去旅行了，下周就回来。
twist.en: Turns out the owner just went travelling. Back next week.

options.zh: 拍了一张关着门的照片，意外地好看
options.en: You take a photo of the closed door. It comes out unexpectedly beautiful

options.zh: 难过了一整天，像失去了一个秘密基地
options.en: You're sad all day, like you've lost a secret hideout

options.zh: 回想起那家店的每一个角落、每一种味道
options.en: You remember every corner of it, and every flavour

options.zh: 随便走走，又发现了一家新的小店
options.en: You wander a bit, and find a new little shop

q.zh: 你的房间
q.en: Your room

options.zh: 每样东西都是挑过的，连插座都是好看的
options.en: Everything in it was chosen. Even the sockets look good

options.zh: 有一个只属于你的角落，谁都不能碰
options.en: There's one corner that is yours alone. Nobody touches it

options.zh: 香薰、毯子、暖光，躺下去就不想起来
options.en: Scent, blanket, warm light. Once you lie down you're not getting up

options.zh: 每个月都按心情重新摆一次
options.en: You rearrange it every month to match your mood

q.zh: 凌晨两点，你在
q.en: It's 2am. You are

options.zh: 改一张照片的调色，改到第十二版
options.en: Colour-grading one photo. Version twelve

options.zh: 一个人戴着耳机，在房间里慢慢跳舞
options.en: Headphones on, dancing slowly alone in your room

options.zh: 泡一杯热巧克力，坐在窗边看夜景
options.en: Making hot chocolate and watching the night from the window

options.zh: 突然想剪头发，第二天真的去剪了
options.en: Suddenly wanting a haircut. You get one the next day

rarity_line.zh: 全世界 11.6% 的人在撑着这个世界正常运转，你是其中一个。
rarity_line.en: 11.6% of people keep the world running on time. You're one of them.

line.zh: 虽然你的原则多到别人记不住，但大家心里都清楚，跟着你走永远不会出错。
line.en: You have more principles than anyone can remember, but everyone knows that following you never goes wrong.

line.zh: 虽然你的备忘录比别人的日记还长，但每次出状况，掏出解决办法的总是你。
line.en: Your notes app is longer than most people's diaries, but when things go wrong, the fix comes out of your pocket.

line.zh: 虽然你嘴上一句软话都没有，但你做的每件事都比软话更暖。
line.en: You never say anything soft, but everything you do is warmer than soft words.

line.zh: 虽然你一件事能死磕到凌晨，但你交出去的东西，从来不用别人再改一遍。
line.en: You'll grind at one thing till past midnight, but nobody ever has to redo what you hand in.

q.zh: 拼好的家具，少了一颗螺丝
q.en: The furniture is built. One screw is missing

options.zh: 拍照标注，发邮件给客服，附上订单号和说明书页码
options.en: Photo, annotation, email to support, with the order number and the manual page

options.zh: 去五金店买一颗一样的，顺便把家里所有螺丝分类装盒
options.en: You buy a matching one at the hardware shop, then sort every screw in the house into labelled boxes

options.zh: 骂了一句，然后顺手帮邻居也检查了一遍他们的家具
options.en: You swear once, then go and check the neighbour's furniture for them too

options.zh: 嘴上说算了，凌晨一点还在研究替代方案
options.en: You say "forget it", and at 1am you're still researching a workaround

q.zh: 朋友说：“随便找家店吃吧”
q.en: A friend says: "Let's just eat anywhere"

options.zh: “随便”是不存在的，去上次那家
options.en: "Anywhere" doesn't exist. Same place as last time

options.zh: 三家备选已发群里，附人均、评分和排队时间
options.en: Three options already in the chat, with price, rating and queue time

options.zh: 回了句“都行”，然后默默订好了位
options.en: You reply "fine with anything", then quietly book a table

options.zh: 研究了四十分钟点评，最后还是去了上次那家
options.en: Forty minutes of reading reviews, then the same place as last time

q.zh: 地铁停在隧道里不动了，广播也没声音
q.en: The train stops in the tunnel. No announcement

twist.zh: 其实只是在等前车出站，二十秒后就开了。
twist.en: Turns out it was just waiting for the train ahead. It moved twenty seconds later.

options.zh: 看表开始计时，以防之后要写投诉
options.en: You check your watch and start timing, in case you need to file a complaint

options.zh: 检查包里：水、充电宝、纸巾都在，安心了
options.en: You check your bag: water, power bank, tissues. All there. Calm

options.zh: 对旁边一脸紧张的阿姨说“慌什么”，然后把座位让给她
options.en: You tell the nervous auntie next to you "nothing to panic about", then give her your seat

options.zh: 继续做今天的待办，没信号就离线做
options.en: You carry on with today's to-do list. No signal, so you do it offline

q.zh: 凌晨两点，你在
q.en: It's 2am. You are

options.zh: 睡觉。凌晨两点就该睡觉
options.en: Asleep. 2am is for sleeping

options.zh: 起夜，顺手把冰箱里过期的东西清掉了
options.en: Up for the toilet, and you clear the expired food out of the fridge on the way back

options.zh: 想白天那句话是不是说重了，决定明天找机会补一句
options.en: Wondering if what you said today was too harsh, and deciding to make it right tomorrow

options.zh: 还在调表格格式，就差一条边框就完美了
options.en: Still fixing the spreadsheet. One border away from perfect

q.zh: 有人插队，就插在你前面
q.en: Someone cuts the queue, right in front of you

options.zh: 礼貌但大声：“后面排队哦。”
options.en: Polite, but loud: "The queue starts back there."

options.zh: 默默记下时间、地点和他衣服的颜色
options.en: You silently note the time, the place and the colour of their shirt

options.zh: 心里骂了三遍，看到他抱着小孩，让他先了
options.en: You curse them three times in your head, see the kid in their arms, and let them go first

options.zh: 不说话，往前站一步，用身体让他明白
options.en: You say nothing. You take one step forward and let your body explain

rarity_line.zh: 全世界 12.3% 的人负责让大家聚在一起，你是其中一个。
rarity_line.en: 12.3% of people bring everyone together. You're one of them.

line.zh: 虽然你总在问别人吃饱没有，但正因为你，每个局都暖暖的。
line.en: You're always asking whether people have eaten, but that's why every gathering feels warm.

line.zh: 虽然你常为了大家开心委屈一点自己，但有你在的群，从来没有吵散过。
line.en: You often give up a little so everyone's happy, but a group with you in it has never fallen apart.

line.zh: 虽然你认识的人多到自己都数不清，但每个人都觉得自己是你的好朋友。
line.en: You know more people than you can count, but each of them thinks they're your close friend.

line.zh: 虽然你记得每个人的纪念日有点夸张，但收到你祝福的人，那天都会特别开心。
line.en: Remembering everyone's anniversaries is a bit much, but whoever gets your message has a better day.

q.zh: 你组了一个聚会
q.en: You've organised a get-together

options.zh: 提前问好每个人的忌口，点菜时一个都没漏
options.en: You asked what everyone can't eat in advance, and missed nobody when ordering

options.zh: 座位都安排好了，确保没人坐在不熟的人旁边
options.en: The seating is planned so nobody sits next to someone they barely know

options.zh: 顺便介绍两个你觉得会合得来的朋友认识
options.en: You introduce two friends you think will click

options.zh: 准备了一个小惊喜，因为今天刚好是某人入职一周年
options.en: You've prepared a small surprise, because it happens to be someone's one-year work anniversary

q.zh: 群里两个朋友因为小事吵起来了
q.en: Two friends start arguing in the group chat over something small

options.zh: 先问吵完的那位吃饭没，要不要一起
options.en: First you ask the one who finished arguing whether they've eaten, and whether they want to come along

options.zh: 分别私聊，先把两边的委屈听完
options.en: You message each of them privately and hear both sides out

options.zh: 拉一个三人小群：“我们见面聊。”
options.en: You make a three-person chat: "Let's talk in person."

options.zh: 提议周末一起吃顿饭，就当翻篇
options.en: You suggest dinner this weekend, to draw a line under it

q.zh: 你给朋友发了生日祝福，一整天都没回
q.en: You sent a friend a birthday message. No reply all day

twist.zh: 其实他手机掉进了马桶，正在用一袋米救它。
twist.en: Turns out their phone fell in the toilet. It's currently recovering in a bag of rice.

options.zh: 担心他是不是不开心，又发了一句关心
options.en: You worry they're unhappy, and send another message to check in

options.zh: 回想是不是自己哪里说错了话
options.en: You go back over whether you said something wrong

options.zh: 问了几个共同朋友，确认他没事
options.en: You ask a few mutual friends to make sure they're okay

options.zh: 不管了，第二天带着蛋糕直接去找他
options.en: Never mind. You turn up the next day with a cake

q.zh: 有新人加入你们的圈子
q.en: Someone new joins your circle

options.zh: 记住了他爱喝什么，下次顺手帮他带一杯
options.en: You note what they drink, and bring them one next time

options.zh: 一直留意着他有没有被冷落
options.en: You keep an eye on whether they're being left out

options.zh: 第一天就把所有群、所有梗都给他讲清楚了
options.en: On day one you explain every group chat and every inside joke

options.zh: 给他办了一个小小的“欢迎入伙”
options.en: You throw them a tiny welcome party

q.zh: 凌晨两点，你在
q.en: It's 2am. You are

options.zh: 想明天怎么让心情不好的朋友开心一点
options.en: Working out how to cheer up a friend who's down tomorrow

options.zh: 斟酌一句话怎么说，才不会让任何人不舒服
options.en: Choosing how to phrase one sentence so nobody is hurt by it

options.zh: 回了十几个人的消息，每一条都认真
options.en: Replying to a dozen people, every message with care

options.zh: 在日历上标好下个月所有人的生日
options.en: Marking everyone's birthdays for next month on the calendar

rarity_line.zh: 全世界 13.8% 的人离不开你，你是最多人的安心感。
rarity_line.en: 13.8% of people are you, and the rest can't live without you.

line.zh: 虽然你记得别人随口提过的每件小事，但正是这些小事，让大家觉得被你放在了心上。
line.en: You remember every little thing people mention in passing, but those little things are how they know they matter to you.

line.zh: 虽然你总把别人的事排在自己前面，但被你护着的人，从来没有真的孤单过。
line.en: You always put other people's problems ahead of your own, but nobody under your wing has ever really been alone.

line.zh: 虽然你做了很多从来不说，但大家心里都知道，少了你，什么都会乱套。
line.en: You do a lot and say nothing, but everyone knows it all falls apart without you.

line.zh: 虽然你不爱变化，但你在的地方，就是大家最安心的地方。
line.en: You don't love change, but wherever you are is where everyone feels safest.

q.zh: 朋友半年前随口说过喜欢某个小零食
q.en: Half a year ago a friend mentioned a snack they liked

options.zh: 你记得，还记得是哪个牌子哪个口味
options.en: You remember. Including the brand and the flavour

options.zh: 每次一起点菜，你都会先帮他避开他不吃的
options.en: Every time you order together, you steer them away from what they can't eat first

options.zh: 他心情不好那天，那包零食刚好出现在他桌上
options.en: On the day they were down, that snack just happened to appear on their desk

options.zh: 你每次路过那家店都顺手带一包，已经带了半年
options.en: You pick up a pack every time you pass the shop. You've done it for six months

q.zh: 群里有人说“好累啊”
q.en: Someone in the group chat says "so tired"

options.zh: 想起他上周说过工作很多，猜到了原因
options.en: You remember they said work was heavy last week, and guess why

options.zh: 立刻私聊问他怎么了
options.en: You message them privately at once to ask what's wrong

options.zh: 什么都没说，第二天给他点了一份外卖
options.en: You say nothing. The next day lunch arrives at their door

options.zh: 回了一句“早点睡”，跟每次一样，他知道你一直在
options.en: You reply "sleep early", same as always. They know you're there

q.zh: 家里人半夜打来电话，响了三声就挂了
q.en: Family calls in the middle of the night. Three rings, then it cuts off

twist.zh: 其实是你妈睡着时压到了手机。
twist.en: Turns out your mum rolled onto her phone in her sleep.

options.zh: 把他们最近说过的每一件小事，一件件在脑子里排查
options.en: You go through everything they've mentioned lately, one item at a time

options.zh: 立刻打回去，心跳快得要命
options.en: You call straight back, heart pounding

options.zh: 已经开始查最早一班回家的车
options.en: You're already looking up the first train home

options.zh: 先深呼吸，然后按顺序给每个家人打过去
options.en: Deep breath first. Then you call each family member in order

q.zh: 小组作业结束了
q.en: The group project is finished

options.zh: 你是唯一一个记得把所有文件备份好的人
options.en: You're the only one who remembered to back up every file

options.zh: 你给每个组员都发了一句“辛苦了”
options.en: You send each teammate a "thank you for the hard work"

options.zh: 你偷偷把别人没做完的部分补好了，没跟任何人说
options.en: You secretly finished the parts others left undone, and told nobody

options.zh: 你把这次的流程整理成模板，下次直接用
options.en: You turn the process into a template for next time

q.zh: 凌晨两点，你在
q.en: It's 2am. You are

options.zh: 在备忘录里记下朋友们最近提过的小愿望
options.en: Noting down the small wishes your friends mentioned lately

options.zh: 回想今天有没有哪句话让别人不舒服
options.en: Going back over today, checking whether anything you said made someone uncomfortable

options.zh: 想明天要给谁带早餐
options.en: Deciding who to bring breakfast for tomorrow

options.zh: 睡了。睡前确认了门锁、燃气和明天的闹钟
options.en: Asleep. After checking the lock, the gas and tomorrow's alarm
